cases.fixture: Synthetic isolated display containing a known test window.
cases.trigger: Invoke the documented fullscreen capture affordance.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record whether the target captures the full display and resulting image bounds.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Invoke CapturePanel onCapture with mode fullscreen and record capture result or error.
cases.acceptance_rule: Compare Ferby with the recorded target result for bounds, cancellation and output availability; do not infer a result before target capture.
cases.limitations: CapturePanel export proves only a UI callback and does not prove native wiring.

cases.source_reference: UI-10 shortcut labels; Interface Builder Evidence ev_7a54c59efe5ad259d8b8b7c187965d29df9ca99f3686ffa068c92add599df2ca
cases.fixture: Synthetic display with a selectable rectangle and an explicit cancel action.
cases.trigger: Invoke area capture, select a bounded rectangle, then repeat with cancellation.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record selected bounds, output dimensions, and cancellation behavior.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Invoke CapturePanel onCapture with mode area and record result/error for selection and cancellation.
cases.acceptance_rule: Pass only when Ferby's recorded selection and cancellation behavior matches a separately recorded target result.
cases.limitations: The named API exposes no rectangle-selection or cancellation contract.

cases.fixture: Synthetic display with two isolated application windows.
cases.trigger: Invoke window capture and target each known window in turn.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record selected window identity, image bounds and behavior when no window is selected.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Invoke CapturePanel onCapture with mode window and record result/error.
cases.acceptance_rule: Compare only against recorded target observations; no window-selection result is assumed from the mode label.
cases.limitations: CapturePanel's public mode list does not establish active/any-window semantics.

cases.source_reference: UI-10, UI-12 and UI-15 scrolling screenshot labels/preferences
cases.fixture: Synthetic scrollable document with known repeated markers and bounded height.
cases.trigger: Invoke scrolling screenshot with maximum height, speed and reverse-autoscroll variants.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record supported-app behavior, stitch quality, stopping condition, reverse direction and height limit.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Record Ferby's scrolling capture output/error and each configured boundary result.
cases.acceptance_rule: Compare stitch bounds, marker order, stopping and limits only after target observations are recorded.
cases.limitations: CapturePanel exposes no scrolling trigger or preference API; integration is not proven.
